description: Sunday 10:00 cron rollup (crons/jobs.json weekly-report). The workflow declares no inputs and tools: [] — the run is board + vault + wiki only. geo-agent claims, reads the keyword list from the vault, replays the week's audit tickets off the board (list_tasks / get_task / list_events), rolls the trend from wiki/Knowledge/GEO/citation-share.md into a weekly digest, files it to wiki, posts the summary as a board comment, queues next week's first move, and completes with result + digest. Also logs one learning under Weekly Learnings in MEMORY.md.
